sanskrit_verse:
दत्त्वा भ्य्यादिकं राजा ताम्रपत्रे पटेsथ वा ।
शासनं कारयेद्धर्मं स्थानवंशादिसंयुतम् ॥
transliteration: dattvā bhyādikaṃ rājā tāmrapatre paṭe 'tha vā / śāsanaṃ kārayed dharmaṃ sthānavāṃśādi saṃyutam //
sph_interpretive_translation: Having given due consideration to foundational dharmic principles, the King shall cause to be issued a royal edict upon copper plate or cloth, ensuring it carries the authority of lineage, place, and continuity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Sanatana Dharma, not personal will
Causation arises through conscious documentation rooted in truth-bearing materials
Capacity-based responsibility requires rulers to act through enduring, verifiable instruments
Restoration logic mandates that governance be anchored in unbroken dharmic lineage
Consciousness alignment is ensured when administrative acts reflect cosmic order
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler issues decree THEN it MUST be inscribed on imperishable medium (copper/stone/fiber)
IF decree lacks genealogical or territorial anchoring THEN it has no juridical force
IF decree contradicts Sanatana Dharma THEN it is automatically null
IF decree supports restoration of dharma THEN its execution precedes all temporal laws
IF decree originates from awakened consciousness THEN it binds across time and realm
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any royal proclamation or state directive must demonstrate continuity with ancestral wisdom and territorial dharma. The court evaluates not merely legality but ontological grounding—verifying whether the act was inscribed through mediums symbolizing permanence and whether it upholds the sovereign integrity of dharma above transient political interest.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here functions as pramāṇa-based establishment of right action via documented form. There is no punitive framework; rather, misaligned proclamations are simply rendered non-binding by their failure to meet dharmic inscription standards. Responsibility flows from capacity to align consciousness with eternal law, not from fear of consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-inscription Protocol: Misaligned decrees must be ritually dissolved and reissued in harmony with dharma
Lineage Verification Process: Ensure continuity of ruling authority with recognized dharmic succession
Territorial Alignment Ceremony: Re-establish connection between governance and sacred geography
Consciousness Reaffirmation Ritual: Ruler undergoes purification to restore alignment before issuing new edicts
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Royal authority manifests only where dharma is inscribed in enduring form, aligned with timeless lineage, and executed without punitive intent. Thus is Dharma restored, reality affirmed as non-punitive, and consciousness declared the ultimate adjudicator.
